<!-- docs-drift-check -->
### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/lint`, touching **9** documentable anchor(s).

⛔ **2** release-owned page(s) name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v16.mdx`  _(via validateWidgetBindings (symbol, a top-level function))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-1.mdx`  _(via validateWidgetBindings (symbol, a top-level function))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **65** of **247** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **182** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **182**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **123** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **4** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json e997113cb058b6eb733179612fff608828e282a6` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `e9c7975a4c92af846c50f578a922c4395f05e3f3` — the merge of head `715ce9e360f7706a34aa8bac1c8b0f3897f68ad0` into base `e997113cb058b6eb733179612fff608828e282a6`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin e9c7975a4c92af846c50f578a922c4395f05e3f3 && git checkout e9c7975a4c92af846c50f578a922c4395f05e3f3
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin e997113cb058b6eb733179612fff608828e282a6 715ce9e360f7706a34aa8bac1c8b0f3897f68ad0 && git checkout -B drift-repro e997113cb058b6eb733179612fff608828e282a6 && git merge --no-ff 715ce9e360f7706a34aa8bac1c8b0f3897f68ad0

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json e997113cb058b6eb733179612fff608828e282a6
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs e997113cb058b6eb733179612fff608828e282a6` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：仪表盘、图表类的 9 条 lint 提示，在运行时保存时会带上用户可读的一句话（11 种平台语言），按请求语言显示；规则 id、`message`、`hint` 和 `os validate`/`os lint` 输出都不变。
- 为什么改：非英语 Studio 里这些提示原来只显示英文；安全类提示已按 #32655 的方式本地化。
- 风险与回滚：只加文案和参数，`@objectstack/lint` patch，`Clause-②: no`；回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`packages/lint/src/validate-widget-bindings.user-text.ts`（7 条句子）和 `finding-user-text.ts` 的合并列表。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/finding-user-text.dashboards.test.ts`，预期全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。非英语句子由 agent 写，已在验收说明里列出，等母语复核。

席位意见：可以落地。

## 席位核对
**ACCEPT** · seat `domain:spec#2` · head `715ce9e3` · 2026-11-13T15:39Z

1. **Shape:** `Fixes #32837`, draft, base `main`, 7 files, +1043/−1; changeset `.changeset/32837-advisory-user-text.md` (`@objectstack/lint` patch). `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none` (precedent #32790's lint half), matching claim 6855540022 and dev report 6856977259.
2. **Premise:** #32655 closed with the `*.user-text.ts` + `mergeUserTextCatalogs` pattern. The dev re-measured through `runRuntimeAuthoringRules`: 9 of the card's 11 ids reach the publish door. The seat agreed in-thread to catalog only those 9; the 2 unreachable ids (`measure-aggregate-incoherent`, `page/visualization-without-binding`) are named in Acceptance notes, under parent #32835's Done-when alternative.
3. **Review:** `dispatch-gates --tier`: no path-derived mandate (packages/lint only, no narrowing face), so this is the seat's own review of record. It read the code diff in full: two catalog imports and the merge list; `userTextParams` at the 9 push sites; on chart bindings only at `position === 'report-series'`, with `report` carried on the report chart binding alone. It spot-checked `chart-axis-not-selected` in 8 locales for `${p.plotted}` / `${p.dataset}` interpolation. The pins assert exact coverage over ids × 11 locales, every push site rendered in every locale, and a runtime-gate `userMessage`.
4. **Gates / check-runs:** dev: lint 203 files / 8639 tests, metadata-protocol consumer 22799 passed, 60/60 derived gates exit 0, 2 ablations red as expected. CI on `715ce9e3`: 66 runs, 55 success, 11 skipped, 0 failed. K = 1, no new locale pack.
5. **Accepted deviations and out-of-scope findings:** the 2 unreachable ids above stay on the English `message`. Agent-written non-English sentences are listed for the native-review round. Sibling #32836 (PR #33120) adds lines to the same `FINDING_USER_TEXT_CATALOG` list; whichever lands second merges main once.
6. **Landing:** not governed (`check-governed-merges --pr 33118`), 1044 changed lines. The seat readies the PR and arms auto-merge under the maintainer's standing words 「车道经理应该使用 pm-dispatch 技能审核和落地pr」. On MERGED: #32837 closes via `Fixes`; `pm:dispatched` comes off.
